meta.title: Monorepo Operations — KB Labs
meta.description: Cross-repo dependency management, build order resolution, and health checks for monorepos that have outgrown ad-hoc scripts.

page.buildLead: Dependency graph + topological order + SHA256 content-addressable cache. Same content — 0ms, regardless of package count.

healthCommands.note: Validate all packages against devkit.yaml rules: naming, tsconfig, eslint, deps.
Workspace health score (A–F), issue counts by category, coverage metrics.
Auto-fix safe violations. Use --dry-run to preview without writing.
Check staged files only. Exits with code 1 on violations. For pre-commit hooks.
List all installed plugins with their version and enabled state.

page.buildTitle: Change one package — only the chain rebuilds.

buildCommands.note: Build all packages in dependency order. Skips unchanged packages via SHA cache.
Build only changed packages and their downstream dependents.
Build a specific package by name.
Chain multiple tasks in one pass, each in correct dep order.

page.healthLead2: Need custom logic? {code} in devkit.yaml — a shell command that receives a JSON package context and returns {result}. License headers, barrel exports, naming conventions — anything.
page.heroDescription: kb-devkit orchestrates the monorepo: topological builds, content-addressable cache, --affected via git diff, health score per preset. We build KB Labs with it every day.
page.healthLead1: Static audit of every package by presets: ESLint config, TSConfig, README, engines, exports. Health score 0–100 with A–F grade — degradation is immediately visible per category.
